g.title:
6. Strategic Physical Branch Network [Physical Branch Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The physical branch presence serving corporate clients, high-net-worth wealth customers, and physical cash operations with dual-uplink SD-WAN routers, Portnox 802.1X NAC switches, teller workstations, Evolis instant card printers, and biometric KYC enrolment desks.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Facilitates physical cash deposits, cash withdrawals, physical cheque deposits, in-person biometric KYC onboarding (NIN/BVN), and instant debit card personalized embossing.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Walk-in Banking Customers, Corporate Cash-in-Transit (CIT) Armored Couriers • OUTBOUND: Primary Data Center Finacle Core via SD-WAN IPsec (Ports 8000-8080), Portnox CLEAR Cloud NAC via 802.1X (UDP 1812), Evolis Card Issuance Server via Local USB/LAN • FAILOVER: Dual-uplink SD-WAN with auto-failover from Metro Fiber (MainOne/21st Century) to 4G/5G Wireless (MTN/Airtel); dual online modular UPS and automated generator ATS. • SECURITY: Portnox 802.1X port authentication, BitLocker endpoint encryption, Cencon vault locks, and CCTV surveillance streamed to Head Office SOC. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

g.text: Cisco / Fortinet Secure Edge Appliance with auto failover:
• IPsec AES-256 Mesh to Primary DC & Secondary DC
• Quality-of-Service (QoS) prioritization for Finacle Teller traffic
• Cloud 802.1X Port Authentication via Portnox CLEAR
• VLAN Segmentation: Teller LAN, Voice VLAN, CCTV, Guest WiFi
Physical cash deposit, withdrawal & customer servicing:
• Hardened Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC endpoints with BitLocker
• Finacle Teller Client connecting to on-prem Primary DC
• Cash Recycler & Note Counter Integration with audit log
Instant debit card issuance & KYC onboarding:
• Instant Card Issuance: Evolis Dualys / Elypso (iCARD)
• Biometric Enrolment: NIMC & BVN finger/facial scanners
• Dual Online Modular UPS with 8-hour battery bank
• Automated Generator with Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS)
• IP CCTV & Vault Access Controls connected to HO SOC
• Strategic branch count focused on high-value corporate & wealth centers
• Zero local database or core computing on-site; 100% centralized at Primary DC
• Branch survivability powered by cached security tokens & dual-telco SD-WAN
